target: DAIHEN Welbee Inverter P350L II, WB-P352L
scope: Independent CC0 geometry, code, and original review renders. No manufacturer CAD, image, texture, dimension drawing, or PDF is redistributed. Fixed standalone dry power source only; no CM-7403, torch, cable, or cooling unit.

sources.facts: P350L II maps to WB-P352L; P500L II maps to WB-P502L. This family URL does not make P502L photos target-specific.

sources.used: Cover exact-model P350L II photo, p7 USB/rear photos, p9 specifications. Inspected actual image pixels; extracted text is not sufficient.

sources.qualification: This is a current Hammer product, not proof of the installed WB-P352L caster. Sizes are used as an explicitly approximate visual choice, consistent with a small-wheel appearance. Old RD50 identity from the excluded manual is not accepted as a dimension source or exact-part equivalence.

sources.used: Manufacturer English catalog p28 lists 420SR-RD50 using 427S-RD50, diameter50 and width26; adjacent p27 gives fixed 420SR D50 height70 and plate70x47. Independent dimensions of the reference caster itself.
sources.qualification: This does not prove that the exact caster is installed on WB-P352L. The welder wheel model remains an appearance approximation; its old-manual identity chain is excluded as authoring authority.

confirmed.height_datum: Ground through wheels to highest front fascia; blue roof is lower.
confirmed.lifting_eyes: Two diagonal positions, front-left and rear-right; dimensions estimated.
confirmed.front_layout: Two tiers; upper tier rakes backward. USB cover is not a grab handle. Lower-right work/torch output pair has the torch post on image-right.
confirmed.rear_layout: Catalog series-level rear photo shows four grommets, covered input terminals, clamp and vent fields. Exact target correspondence and local dimensions remain estimates.
confirmed.excluded_variant: WB-P502L / P500L II is 395 x 710 x 810 mm, not the same-height cabinet.

visual_estimates.other: Corner contour, all local feature coordinates and diameters, panel returns, slots, caster brackets, blank labels and hidden underside are authored approximations. Materials are visual estimates; pale molded fascia uses low metalness without asserting exact resin. Rear uses family-level photo evidence.
visual_estimates.caster_reference: Current Hammer 420SR-R50, 50 mm diameter /26 width /70 mounting height. Not verified as the actual installed WB-P352L part.

compatibility.unchanged: All links, fixed joints, frame origins, and two primitive collision envelopes are byte-identical. No fabricated inertial tensor.
compatibility.torch_outlet: Legacy routing marker [-0.060,-0.355,0.300] m, not a measured physical socket center. Detailed visual posts are in the lower-right bay instead.
compatibility.simulation_limits: Static layout/reference geometry only. No wheel dynamics, welding, thermal, electrical or safety simulation. Components individually closed; overlapping assembly is not a fused manifold shell.

excluded_sources.used: Inspected during research but excluded as a new dimensional authoring authority under CONTRIBUTING because of its reproduction prohibition. Not redistributed.
excluded_sources.legal: Publicly accessible primary facts and appearance reference. Copyright notice reserves DAIHEN rights; do not reproduce the document, its illustrations, or photos.

inherited_compatibility_geometry.status: Retained from baseline r1 authoring; not newly validated dimensions from an eligible source. Historical source was the now-excluded manual; retaining geometry does not certify that source.
